messages.content: What are the components of Civil Law?

message.content:
Civil law, also known as civil jurisprudence or civil law system, is a legal framework that governs non-criminal disputes between private parties. Its components can be broadly categorized into the following areas: | Component | Description | Key Elements | |-----------|-------------|--------------| | **Legal Sources** | The foundational texts and authorities that create, interpret, and apply civil law. | • **Statutes & Codes** (e.g., Civil Code, Commercial Code)
• **Regulations & Ordinances**
• **Case Law** (precedents, judicial opinions)
• **Customary Law** (in some jurisdictions) | | **Legal Principles** | Core doctrines that guide the interpretation and application of the law. | • **Contractual Freedom**
• **Good Faith & Fair Dealing**
• **Doctrine of Res Ipsa Loquitur**
• **Doctrine of Unjust Enrichment** | | **Legal Procedures** | The processes and rules governing how civil matters are brought before courts and resolved. | • **Jurisdiction & Venue**
• **Pleadings & Motions**
• **Discovery**
• **Trial & Judgment**
• **Appeals** | | **Legal Remedies** | The outcomes or reliefs available to parties who win a civil case. | • **Damages (Compensatory, Punitive, Nominal)**
• **Injunctions**
• **Specific Performance**
• **Restitution** | | **Legal Institutions** | Bodies that enforce civil law and administer justice. | • **Courts (Civil Courts, Family Courts, Commercial Courts)**
• **Arbitration Panels**
• **Mediation Services** | | **Legal Actors** | Individuals and entities involved in civil law processes. | • **Plaintiff / Claimant**
• **Defendant / Respondent**
• **Litigants**
• **Counsel / Attorneys**
• **Judges / Arbitrators** | | **Legal Topics** | Specific areas of civil law that address particular types of disputes. | • **Contract Law**
• **Tort Law**
• **Property Law**
• **Family Law**
• **Inheritance & Succession Law**
• **Commercial Law**
• **Consumer Protection Law** | | **Legal Ethics & Professional Responsibility** | Standards governing the conduct of legal professionals. | • **Confidentiality**
• **Conflict of Interest**
• **Duty of Competence** | ### How These Components Interact 1. **Legal Sources** provide the text of the law. 2. **Legal Principles** help interpret those texts. 3. **Legal Procedures** dictate how disputes are brought and adjudicated. 4. **Legal Remedies** are the outcomes that courts award. 5. **Legal Institutions** and **Actors** carry out the processes. 6. **Legal Topics** focus on specific subject matters within civil law. 7. **Ethics** ensure that the practice of law remains fair and professional. Understanding these components gives a comprehensive view of how civil law functions in practice, from drafting contracts to resolving disputes in court.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What are the components of Civil Law?" They want an explanation. No function call needed. Just answer.
